findings.evidence: The four Phase 1 tests in tests/test_ledger.py each need a ledger file with shuffled or multi-month rows. The plan names no shared location for that setup. The ledger_file fixture is defined in tests/test_export.py (Phase 2), so tests/test_ledger.py cannot use it cleanly. The four tests would clone the setup. Name one shared location (for example tests/conftest.py) and move ledger_file there. Also fold the nine Phase 3 error tests that repeat the assertion shape (return 2, one error: line, no Traceback, out path absent) into one parametrize table with an input column. The bad-month test already uses this pattern. This is the carried tb-A03. It leaves DRY at 6, below the floor of 7.

test_export_out_writes_file_and_prints_count says assert the file content, but the plan gives no expected bytes. State the exact file text, with CRLF, so the test pins acceptance 4. Carried from tb-A05.

The non-goal 'The export only reads ledger.json. It does not write to it' has no test. A mutant that writes the ledger during export survives. Add to test_export_month_lists_only_that_month_oldest_first an assertion that the ledger file bytes are unchanged after the run. Carried from tb-A01.
